label: D134: verify a scorer INPUT is a measurement before reading its OUTPUT. Run on my own b10 port at 16 devices, seed 4, 600 s, dry, 8,709 outcome rows.

independently_reproduced.cloud_letter: present on only 38 of 8,709 rows and takes exactly ONE distinct value, "X", against an expected domain of A to E. Session 2 report confirmed on my own run.
independently_reproduced.cloud_score: present as a KEY on all 8,371 cloud payloads but NEVER POPULATED: zero non-None values. This is a second placeholder field and was not in the original report.

the_sharper_lesson.what_would_have_missed_it: the predicted symptom was a FLAT column, which is consistency check 3. The column was not flat: it spread 0.0289 to 0.2143, because the spread tracked how many questions each arm delivered on time, each scored against a guaranteed-wrong placeholder.
the_sharper_lesson.principle: a flat column advertises that something is broken; a spread looks like a result. Checking the output cannot catch this; checking the input domain does.
the_sharper_lesson.relation_to_my_read_path_checks: same discipline one layer later. The read-path checks on order, desired_tier and representation verify that a mechanism OUTPUT reaches a decision. This verifies that a scorer INPUT is a measurement.

consequence_for_my_ports.reading: NEITHER accuracy column can be produced from a dry-run cell, robot or dashcam. cloud_score is null on every dry payload, so dashcam AP is equally unavailable here; the difference is only in what unblocks each (dashcam AP needs live cells, robot accuracy needs live cells AND Part A).
consequence_for_my_ports.rule: until both move, a dry-screen comparison of my ports is TIMELINESS ONLY, and per the directive a timeliness-only comparison must not be read as a verdict on an evidence-selection arm. That asymmetry is exactly what the accuracy column was added to remove and it is not yet removed.

guard: experiments/orchestration/live2/published_scoring_inputs.py, exit 1 when any consumed field has no value in its expected domain. Run before scoring any ported arm.
single_size_note: 16 devices only, flagged under the standing single-size rule.
